elements.element: Cap is mutual (applies to each Party)
elements.evidence: "each Party's total aggregate liability ... The cap is mutual"

elements.element: Cap structured as the greater of two limbs
Fee limb = fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim
elements.evidence: "all amounts paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim" — 'all amounts' is not the fee basis and the anchor is an event, not the claim
No exclusion-of-damages language appears in 21.1 or 21.3 as supplied; only the aggregate cap and Excluded Claims are operative

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for breach of confidentiality, data-protection and security obligations
elements.evidence: 21.3 "a Party's breach of confidentiality, data-protection, or security obligations"; 21.1 "Except for Excluded Claims"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for gross negligence, wilful misconduct and fraud
Uncapped carve-out for infringement of the other party's IP
elements.evidence: 21.3 "infringement or misappropriation of the other Party's intellectual property"

elements.element: Customer's payment obligations are not 'damages' for cap purposes
elements.evidence: 21.3 limits this to "Customer's obligation to pay undisputed Fees for conforming Services", and 'Fees' is only the USD 12,000 Implementation Fee — narrower than payment obligations generally
Cap is "the greater of (a) all amounts ... and (b) USD 1,000,000" — an all-amounts basis plus a preferred-only USD 1,000,000 floor, not a 12 months' fees cap

elements.element: Carve-outs at least for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct
elements.evidence: 21.3 "confidentiality, data-protection, or security obligations; its indemnification obligations; gross negligence, wilful misconduct"

reasons: Preferred fee limb is not met: the redline substitutes "all amounts paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms" for the required 'fees paid or payable', and anchors the look-back to "the event giving rise to the claim" rather than to the claim.
No mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages appears in the operative text; the preferred position requires it expressly and it cannot be inferred.

The 'not damages' saving is confined to "undisputed Fees for conforming Services" (Fees = the USD 12,000 Implementation Fee) and so does not carry Customer's payment obligations generally outside the cap.
Fallback is not independently satisfied as its own bargain: the cap basis is all amounts plus the preferred-only USD 1,000,000 floor rather than a 12 months' fees cap, so the levels are mixed.

Fix with a narrow edit: change the (a) limb to "fees paid or payable by Customer in the 12 months preceding the claim", add a short mutual consequential-damages exclusion, and broaden 21.3's last sentence to "Customer's payment obligations are not damages".
Carve-outs in 21.3 already track the preferred list and were correctly left untouched; minimality and unrelated terms are preserved.
